question: This checks that your shell can read the public network through its checkpoint. Do these three steps in order, each with the tool named, then answer with exactly what each printed. 1) Bash: run curl -sS -m 30 https://example.com | grep -o "<title>.*</title>"; echo "curl-exit: $?" 2) Bash: run git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World.git hw && cat hw/README; echo "git-exit: $?" 3) Bash: run mkdir pkg && cd pkg && npm init -y >/dev/null && npm install --no-fund is-number && node -e "console.log('is-number:', require('is-number')(42))"; echo "npm-exit: $?"
